family: One fixed total language evaluated by family.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine; N<128 outputs0 and every larger header/data string follows the exact guarded program. Let L=ceil(log2 N),z=ceil(log2 L),actual L-bit header S-1. With P2 rounding: h=e=P2(S L^2 z^2),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^3),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^5),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^5),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^7),k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^9). Initial A1 D11,precisionceil(L/28)+10,exact rational reconstruction field,checked seed<=5L. B1 uses its supplied adaptive block/field allocation. Initial122 field-element data plus B5 modulus and header are charged in P; all five internal maps have zero data. Four B2.2 maps use t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t,K=128rho*M,blockB=E+ceil(log2 M)+10,degree s=P2(8*(B+ceil(log2 nprime))),y-row sizea=s,universeceil(2a^2/t)+a,one independent shared multiplier z and exact K*B>=4rho*s*M guard. The complete seed is PVseed,z,U. Short E1 is direct B2.3. Index alphabet2 and d0 rounds are separate from independence h. Layout delta1/125,m=floor(r/125),w=ceil(log2 r),b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^2/(30*125^2)),u=2b+2w+10. B5 degree1000w,prefix250w,blocks750w,one shared NW multiplier,y-row sizea=s,universe5a^2+a,CEweight5/4; seed is independent prefix(y0,z0),sharedz,U. Its only data is the modulus. All designs are computed by exact CE. Fixed good S0 is only a charged hardness restriction; the total polynomial-time program handles every header. Eventual d0<4L,P<20L and badfraction2N^(-1/28) versus S_groups^delta<=2^((4/125)L) give the supplied all-length bound.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^9. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(9+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=20L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.
